newsitem.title: DUBAI: ADGAS targets over eight mln LNG tonnes next year.
newsitem.headline: ADGAS targets over eight mln LNG tonnes next year.

text.p: Abu Dhabi Gas Liquefaction Co Ltd (ADGAS) said on Wednesday it planned to produce over eight million tonnes of liquefied natural gas (LNG) in 1997 despite some scheduled maintenance work this year.
A statement carried by the United Arab Emirates (UAE) state-run news agency after a meeting of the company's board of directors said ADGAS "had achieved all targets for 1996".
It quoted ADGAS as saying in its magazine that 1996 output reached around eight million tonnes of LNG, compared with 7.4 million tonnes in 1995.

The company said it had adopted new mechanisms, systems and marketing strategies to brace for tough competition from new LNG suppliers, Egypt, Oman and Qatar -- due to come on stream by the turn of the century.
Its main LNG customer is Tokyo Electric Power Co (TEPCO). Others include, Spanish distributor Engas, Belgium's Distrigaz and Gaz de France.
